result.brief: 提出 Prism 双向自教学后训练方法，将自生成交错轨迹解耦为文本链与图像链并按可靠性构造训练目标，统一提升多模态理解与生成。
result.reason: Proposes bidirectional self-teaching post-training for unified multimodal models, deriving reliability-guided targets from self-generated interleaved text/image rollouts to jointly improve understanding and generation.
